title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Aisha Kumar
release_notes: Enhances Dedicated autoscaler with priority-aware burst controls and improved utilization metrics. Adds new Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboard panels; no customer-facing API changes.
description: Context: customers using Redwood Dedicated reported uneven burst behavior across priority classes and lack of clear per-priority utilization visibility. Motivation: make burst capacity guarantees predictable by priority and add observability to detect priority contention. This PR implements prioritized burst token buckets, smoother token refill to reduce oscillation, and additional utilization reporting hooks so SRE and customers can reason about per-priority capacity use. Design summary: 1) Introduce priority token buckets in the dedicated autoscaler runtime with per-priority config (burst_size, refill_rate, smoothing_window). 2) Implement a fast-path in the request router to check burst availability before enqueuing to reduce queue pressure. 3) Add new Prometheus metrics: dedicated_autoscaler_burst_tokens{priority}, dedicated_autoscaler_burst_used_tokens_total{priority}, dedicated_autoscaler_queue_depth_by_priority, dedicated_autoscaler_effective_throughput_by_priority. 4) Emit utilization events to the fleet manager with a new lightweight schema used by the utilization-reporting service to power dashboards. 5) Add a canary rollout: config flag enable_priority_burst_controls default off for 24h, then enabled by default after monitoring. Checklist: - [x] Design doc posted in Linear ENG-8741 - [x] Unit tests for token bucket and smoothing - [x] Integration tests for router fast-path and queueing behavior - [x] Prometheus metrics and dashboard updates - [x] Backwards-compatible config and migration path - [x] E2E smoke test against a small dedicated fleet Changes include: code in services/dedicated-autoscaler (core token bucket and scheduler), services/fleet-manager (utilization event sinks), console/observability (prometheus registry and dashboard JSON), integration tests in infra/tests/dedicated_autoscaler, and a feature flag entry in config/service_defaults. Related work: builds on earlier tokenbucket smoothing PRs (see ENG-2169000 family) and ties into reporting endpoints added in PR pr-2234501. Testing and CI: added unit and integration tests, mocked metrics in test harness. One flaky integration test (TestQueuePriorityStarvation) was observed in initial CI run and fixed by adding a small backoff in the router; CI re-ran and passed. Rollout plan: feature gate rollout to 10% of fleets for 12h, monitor new metrics and error rates, then progressive rollout to 100% over 48h with instant rollback capability. Backwards compatibility: existing autoscaler config continues to work; new priority keys are optional. Why merge now: this addresses customer incident SUP-1123 and unlocks per-priority SLO guarantees for Dedicated customers.
